I read the whole file. I also read the neighbouring definitions it builds on: parabolicRieszShell, parabolicRieszKernel, parabolicRho₂, cylinderPowerIntegral and morreyCell. The file has only two definitions of its own.

- `positiveShell` is `parabolicRieszShell R (n : ℤ) z` with the index restricted to ℕ. It is a thin specialisation of a project definition and does not reproduce a Mathlib concept.
- `parabolicTailKernelConstant` is a problem-specific `tsum` of ENNReal powers of 2. I found no Mathlib concept that it duplicates.

The private lemma `ennreal_mul_rpow` is a theorem-level restatement of an ENNReal `mul_rpow` fact, so the rubric excludes it. I found no other definition or structure in the file that reimplements an existing Mathlib, Batteries or Lean core concept.
